chars.GIRL: a Moroccan girl about 19 with long wavy black hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie, light blue wide-leg jeans, white sneakers and small gold hoop earrings
chars.SALEH: a Moroccan young man about 20 with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a dusty grey t-shirt, a yellow tiler's apron, beige work trousers and black knee pads
chars.TEEN: a Moroccan 17-year-old boy with short curly black hair, wearing a red and black varsity jacket, dark jeans and a black backpack
chars.HAJ: a heavy Moroccan man in his late 50s with a short grey beard, wearing a white polo shirt, beige chinos and sunglasses pushed up on his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Construction site of a luxury villa with an unfinished swimming pool in Casablanca. Seen from where the tiler kneels on the floor: GIRL stands next to HAJ, head-to-waist framing, she ignores her father talking and stares intensely straight toward the viewer with a curious half-smile, arms crossed. Bright daylight, 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SALEH kneeling on a half-tiled floor at a villa construction site, holding a trowel, frozen and looking up in surprise as he recognizes someone off-screen, eyebrows raised. Head-to-waist, daylight, 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, slightly warm faded colors: GIRL in front of the iron gate of a Moroccan private high school, schoolbag on one shoulder, standing alone at the curb looking down the street. Students walking in the background. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, warm faded colors: GIRL waiting at the curb in front of a high school as a black luxury car with a driver pulls up, she glances back over her shoulder. Moroccan city street. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, warm faded colors: TEEN walking along a Casablanca sidewalk with his backpack, passing a public high school with a Moroccan flag over the entrance, another fancier school visible further down the same street. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, warm faded colors: TEEN walks past on the sidewalk pretending not to look, while GIRL standing at her school gate in the background follows him with her eyes. Both faces visible, street with palm trees. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, warm faded colors: GIRL leaning on her school gate, watching someone walk past off-screen, a small knowing smile, her friends chatting behind her. Head-to-waist. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: GIRL walking into a quiet upscale Casablanca neighbourhood of white villas with palm trees and high walls at sunset, looking back over her shoulder. 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside an unfinished villa: SALEH holding a tile and a trowel, sweating nervously, glancing sideways; in the doorway behind him GIRL leans on the frame staring at him intensely without blinking. Both faces visible, daylight. 2D animated storybook style.
